subject: Environmental Studies
stem: When the Moon comes between the Sun and the Earth, blocking sunlight from reaching parts of the Earth, this event is called a:

options.option_text: New moon only, with no special name

explanation: A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Sun and Earth, casting a shadow on Earth — occurs only during a new moon.

subject: Environmental Studies
stem: When the Earth comes between the Sun and the Moon, blocking sunlight from reaching the Moon and causing it to darken, this event is called a:

options.option_text: Full moon only, with no special name

explanation: A lunar eclipse occurs when the Earth passes between the Sun and Moon, casting Earth's shadow on the Moon — occurs only during a full moon.
